A branch bows between your friend and the blade. As it springs back, the green closes over their escape.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
One visible willing ally within 3 squares occupying rooted vegetation, before it defends against an attack dealing physical damage.
Type
Magic / Defense / Movement

The ally gains 2 Boons to this defense. After the attack resolves, it may move up to 3 squares without provoking, starting through the vegetation around it.
